about: Spike 1431 call log: every forge call the spike made, merged from both hosts, in time order. Entries without 'reconstructed' were logged by the spike's forge client at call time: ts is the request start and ms its duration, so ts+ms is when the response completed. purpose separates production calls (mirror-read, mirror-write, setup, teardown) from instrumentation (readback, measure, edit-drift, scan reads). Entries with reconstructed: true are calls made by hand with gh, git or curl. They were not logged when made; each is rebuilt from the transcript entry named in its source, and its note says which fields are not measured.
